notes.title: Wingspan Patch - July 14th
notes.content:
[b][h2]Birders,[/h2]

[h2]A real chonky patch just landed on Steam![/h2][/b]
[h3]This update fixes a bunch of bugs you’ve reported since the Asia Expansion launch, bringing improved performance and stability, and including a few small changes to birds you know well by now!

[b]Here’s what changed in the patch:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will not be able to back out from playing Wrybill after already seeing the discard pile
[*] Wingspans updated for Count Raggis Bird of Paradise, Horsfields Bushlark, Malleefowl, Pesquets Parrot, Pheasant Coucal
[/list]
[b]Here’s what’s been fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Wetland bonus conversions allowing for indefinite activations when used alternately.
[*] 'Historian' bonus card displaying an incorrect % of birds.
[*] #ERROR displaying instead of the sum of wingspans during push-your-luck powers in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, and Italian.
[*] Grey Butcherbird tucking birds with a 40 cm wingspan.
[*] Some bird powers rerolling dice being not predictible in Champ of the Birds mode.
[*] Pink powers not allowing the reset of the birdfeeder when triggered by Automa.
[*] "Fewest Duet tokens on bonus spaces" goal not displaying correctly on Automa's screen.
[*] Birds in the online menu covering active games.
[*] Black Drongo and Red-Wattled Lapwing not displaying the "no return" arrow appropriately during activation.
[*] AI placing Duet tokens on spaces with beak pointing left/right when playing a bird pointing forward.
[*] Playing a second bird in the same turn (via another bird's power) in Duet mode unable to be undone.
[*] Resetting the tray with a Duet token when selecting a card in the tray being inconsistent for Yellow Bittern compared with other card-drawing powers.
[*] "Refill Tray" option displaying as active after resetting the tray with a Duet token.
[*] Bluethroat and Common Nightingale's powers not displaying the "back" button in some cases.
[*] Eurasian Collared-Dove not counting towards Anatomist bonus card
[*] Issues when playing Montagu's Harrier and Southern Cassowary in overview mode.
[*] Paying food costs with seed cached on Coal Tit not allowing placing duet token on appropriate space
[*] Food cached on Coal Tit restoring more than it should when player undoes playing bird action
[*] Satyr Tragopan not restoring card when undoing its power
[*] Playing Rose-Ringed Parakeet in overview mode
[*] Minor Tutorial fixes.
[*] Minor UI and sound fixes.
[*] Global Analyst Achievement not unlocking after scoring a bonus card with Red-Crowned Crane and Great Indian Bustard's powers, and not taking copied bonus cards into account.
[/list]
[b]For those of you playing with a controller, we’ve made a few improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] The "undo" action available when a pop-up to confirm an action was active.
[*] Trying to play a bird without the required food using a GAME END power, displaying a non-interactive pop-up.
[*] Backing out of the Grassland bonus conversion action resulting in the controller losing focus. 
[/list]
Thanks so much for all your feedback and reports, they are always a huge help! 
We hope this update smooths things out and makes your experience even better. And of course, we hope you’re enjoying the Asia Expansion!

Have a great week,
Monster Couch Team[/h3]

notes.title: Wingspan: Asia Expansion is Now Available on Steam! New Birds Await!
notes.content: [h2][b]Birders, it’s here![/b] [/h2][h3][/h3][h3][b]Wingspan: Asia Expansion is officially live[/b] and ready to bring a fresh wave of strategic depth, beauty, and variety to your preserve.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]In Asia Expansion, you will explore the vibrant ecosystems of the East, encountering a stunning variety of new birds, each with unique powers that can completely change how you approach your game. Whether you are a returning birder or just getting started, Asia offers new layers to master and new possibilities to uncover![/h3][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="4hIuEUzS6mA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]At the heart of this expansion is the Duet Mode, a brand-new way to play designed specifically for two players. Compete on a shared map, place tokens with purpose, and adapt to special end-of-round goals that keep each session dynamic and engaging. Duet Mode is available both offline and online. It also works in real-time matchmaking for everyone, even if you do not own the expansion![/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]Beyond new gameplay, this expansion brings a range of stunning visuals and outstanding music. Soak in four gorgeous backgrounds inspired by the diverse regions of Asia, and choose from eight beautifully crafted new player portraits to bring a fresh look to your digital birdwatching experience. All of it is accompanied by a serene and immersive new soundtrack by Paweł Górniak.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]For new players or those wanting to refresh their knowledge, the tutorial has been completely reworked. It's now clearer, easier to follow, and comes with in-game rewards for completion. Two new tutorials - one focused on the Asia bird powers and the other on Duet Mode will help you understand the new rules and get ready to play with confidence.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]Automa has also been updated to reflect the new rules introduced in this expansion. She now reacts to bird powers that benefit other players, and you will find smarter interactions and more transparency when playing against her, thanks to improved UI and gameplay tweaks.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]Ready to test your skills against new challenges, discover rare birds, and fly through new, enchanting landscapes?[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]Wingspan: Asia Expansion has landed! [/h3][h3]Your journey with the birds of the East begins now![/h3]

notes.title: Shorter Turns Are Coming To Wingspan April 16!
notes.content:
[h3]We heard your feedback, Birders! 

On [b]April 16[/b], we’re trimming the turn timer in real-time multiplayer from [b]5 minutes to 3 minutes[/b]. This means less waiting, more playing, and a smoother flow without long pauses!
Before the change goes live, our servers will undergo short maintenance works.

notes.title: Automarazzi is here!
notes.content:
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/47c8b66583eaa07159b2efdbac9d2a287ce42daa.png[/img]

Hi, Birders! 

[b]We’re thrilled to introduce a new game mode in Wingspan Digital - Automarazzi![/b]

Automarazzi is [b]a cooperative experience[/b] where human players play together against a common opponent - the Automarazzi.

The Automarazzi make a fortune selling photographs of interesting and rare birds to bird tabloids and television shows. They couldn’t care less about the impact of their fumbling and stomping around the birds’ habitats.

You and your fellow bird enthusiasts unite to stand against this evil photographer. Your mission: to outsmart the greedy Automarazzi and protect our feathered friends and their habitats! Work together to outscore your opponent and enjoy Wingspan Digital like never before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/56a21c231bac211a9363901538b1ec7ac2595bec.gif[/img]

The Automarazzi mode brings you an entirely [b]new exchange system[/b] to manage resources with other players and help each other in the game. You can give away bird cards, and take eggs from other players. If you play with the Automa’s Hoard variant, you can additionally give away food. You can do it anytime during your turn, but remember: these actions have their costs! 

To help you navigate through the new rules, and give you quick access to your knowledge, with this update we’re introducing another new feature - [b]the Automa Rulebook! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/afc3c69c49aa76b0bece89038abbfb987f33ecbc.gif[/img]

[b]It’s also available for everyone for free! [/b]

[b]The Automarazzi comes as a part of the Oceania Expansion but it’s available for everyone in the Online mode.[/b]

We hope you’ll enjoy Automarazzi mode with your friends or solo, and discover a new way to challenge yourself. Share your scores with us wherever you can! 

[b]The update is live now, introducing a bunch of bug fixes as well, so remember to update your game![/b]

[list]
[*] Automarazzi mode added in offline (through Play > Automa > Game mode > Automarazzi) and online (Online > Automarazzi)

[*] New portrait for Automarazzi

[*] Settings for a new game stay saved after starting the game or coming back to main menu
[*] Reworked Pileated Woodpecker, Western Meadowlark and Lazuli Bunting powers - now they can be activated even when the player does not have egg slots available but opponents/teammates do

[*] Automa's bonus card partially covered by UI on some screen ratios
[*] GameEnd powers drawing bonus cards showing the same selection of cards when activated one after another

Happy gaming, and may your scores soar high![/h3]

notes.title: A new nesting place - Wingspan is coming to PlayStation!
notes.content:

Today is announcement day. For some time now, there has been one major hardware that was missing a nest for the birds of Wingspan. We’re finally happy to announce that we’re bringing the game to the last of the 3 big consoles on the market. You could say it’s the final nest, the final station.

[h1]Wingspan is coming to PlayStation![/h1]

There’s lots of good news to unpack here, so let’s go with a bullet point approach this time:[list]
[*] The game will be coming to both the PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 consoles, so owners of both will be able to enjoy the relaxing bird-chirping and card-laying.
[*] Aside from the base game, all DLCs and seasonal decorative packs will also be available at launch, separately and in bundles! These include: European Expansion, Oceania Expansion, Seasonal Bundle & Woodland Wonders Decorative Pack.
[*] Cross-platform multiplayer will be playable at launch! This means you’ll be able to jump into a game with friends or strangers, regardless of which platform they play on. We’re keeping up with the tradition of bringing the Wingspan players family together!
[*] As for the release date, we’ll be sharing it real soon, so keep your eyes peeled for the announcement.
[*] And last, but certainly not least - the PlayStation edition of Wingspan will be coming to the platform in both digital and physical form! Thanks to our friends and partners at Merge Games, we’ll be bringing you a Special Edition box that will not only include the base game, but also the European & Oceania Expansions and the Seasonal Decorative bundle![/list]

And for those of you who like to watch trailers during breaks from birdwatching, here’s a short announcement video we prepped for the occasion:

[previewyoutube=_0R9rPeXoY0;full][/previewyoutube]

Honestly, we’re super happy to finally be able to launch the game on the final big platform that the Sony PlayStation is. As mentioned above, the release date announcement is coming soon. And just as a heads-up, we’ll also be sending another, smaller news your way tomorrow - have your inbox beaks ready to catch that worm fresh.

Have a wonderful day and see you tomorrow!

notes.title: 🌟 Friendly Reminder: Dive into Wingspan's New Online Today! 🌟
notes.content:
[h3]Hello again, Birders!

Just a quick nudge to let you know that the brand-new online update for Wingspan is officially live! 🦢🌿

🕹[b]Friendship ended with ChilliConnect, now Nakama is our best friend[/b]
Our previous online infrastructure, ChilliConnect, is now disconnected from Wingspan. We are moving to a new online system because we need a new infrastructure that will be stable and serve us and our players for years. We want online to work as well as possible and for every game to run without any problems. Online games that were active or saved before the new online update are now unavailable. To play online games again you need to get the update.

🔄 [b]Resetting the Karma[/b]
The introduction of the new online gives all players a chance for a fresh start. Each player's karma points will be restored to the base value.

📱 [b]iOS Players[/b]
Enter new online at Wingspan to set your previous nickname. It will not be possible if another player takes that name faster than you do.

🎈 [b]Two Weeks of Double Karma[/b]
Enjoy double karma points for your completed games for the next two weeks.


Below is the list of changes which you can expect with the update:

[b]Steam:[/b][list]
[*] Online service transferred to the new provider;
[*] Online games from before the update are no longer available;
[*] User accounts are transferred to the new servers;
[*] Karma points are reset to the default value;
[*] Custom online games no longer have a timer;
[*] Finished online games can now be deleted from the online menu without entering them.
[*] Minor online fixes.[/list]
Known issue: 
Error 401 may appear - returning to the main menu and entering online again fixes the issue.

[b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] This is the first time when new online is available for a large group of players. We expect the unexpected, some previously undetected issues may appear. If this happens please let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/wingspan]Discord’s[/url] #bug-reports and via e-mail. We’re going to fix all the potential issues as soon as possible. Thank you for understanding.

Don't miss out and spread your wings and experience Wingspan's digital skies now!

Enjoy your play,
Wingspan Team[/h3]

notes.title: Wingspan Patch Notes - November 12 - Update
notes.content:
Chirp chirp, birders!

Today's patch is like a warbler - it's not a big one, but it's cute and fluffy. Can updates be cute and fluffy, you ask? Sure they can, as long as they bring something new and make something better. This update's just that.

Here are the details:

[list]
[*][b]Features[/b]:
- Hard AI (beta) option added

[*][b]Misc[/b]:
- Improved performance on weaker devices
[/list]


Test your habitat creating prowess against the hard AI now and see who comes out on top! Be aware though - this thing's not a cute fluffy warbler!

Thank you so much for being a part of the Wingspan community. As always, let us know if there's anything we might help with. Also, be sure to join our fantastic Discord community - discord.gg/wingspan.

notes.title: Don't get spooked - Become the Champ of the Birds! Wingspan Halloween update!
notes.content:
Do you hear that?

Someone... something's knocking on the window. You try to see what it is, but you can't. The thick fog outside, illuminated only by the faint candlelight of the Halloween pumpkin on the windowsill, makes it hard to distinguish shapes. As you get closer, the silhouette becomes sharper, clearer. A chill goes down your spine. You might not have been expecting it, but it's here nonetheless...

The Wingspan Halloween update! It's big and spooky and if you're expecting treats, it's got plenty! 

[list]
[*] [b]NEW MODE: Champ of the Birds[/b] - this completely new game mode is a weekly ladder for those of you birders who like to compete. Each week, you face an entirely new Automa challenge. Once you beat it, your score is saved and at the end of each week, the person who managed to score the most points is crowned as the Champ of the Birds! 

[*] [b]Halloween background[/b] - this sinister, foggy landscape will be available in the game for the duration of the Halloween event. 

[*] [b]Bugfixes[/b]:
- fix for playing a second bird via bird power on the overview screen
- fix for "repeat a brown power" on the overview screen
- cards on the Automa screen that should not be clickable are no longer clickable
- fix for some typos
- fix for warning popups on overview screen

[*][b]Misc[/b]:
- Chinese voice over and card fixes (some birds have better names now)
[/list]


And remember - don't get spooked... if you get hooked (on playing Wingspan)!

We hope you enjoy the new mode and the fixes make the experience better. As always, let us know if there's anything we might help with. Also, be sure to join our fantastic Discord community - [b]discord.gg/wingspan[/b].

notes.title: Wingspan Patch Notes - 10/08 Update
notes.content:
Hey, bird enthusiasts! 

We’re back with another set of fixes that should make the game more relaxing to play (because less bugs and qol changes, yay!). It might also make you grow feathers, but this is a known side-effect - don’t panic and consult your doctor if you start seeing feather growing symptoms. 

Here's the list of changes, additions and fixes:

- Introduced a way to quickly switch between online matches through the Pause menu.
- Local custom games setup will now remember your last setup.
- Entering the Overview screen during setup hides the setup now.
- Clicking on another player’s portrait to see their game area will now also display their “last action taken” pop-up.
- “Repeat a brown power to repeat a brown power to repeat a brown power to repeat a brown power” bug fixed.
- Player names in online games will now be visible on the end-game screen.
- Interjection popups fixed for leaving to the main menu and coming back to the game.
- Fixed an issue with AI spamming the log.
- Fixed a number of issues related to match slots in the online menu.
- Fixed a number of issues related to how end-of-round goals were calculated.
- Fixed a number of issues in localizations.
- Fixed a number of typos.

As always, if you encounter any issues while playing, please drop us a line at support@monstercouch.com or let us know via our discord: https://discord.gg/wingspan, where you can also chat with fellow players.

And, if you're enjoying Wingspan, please consider taking a moment to leave a review -- they can go a long way in helping new players discover the game.

Thanks for your support!
Monster Couch Team

notes.title: Wingspan Update 9/23 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi! Here's the list of changes:

- Added a warning when trying to start a local custom game without a human player.
- The start-of-turn bell audio is now also played when your pink power is activated and you need to make a decision.
- When your action triggers other player's pink power a pop-up will appear to let you know about it.
- There is now a popup asking you if you're sure you want to join a matchmaking game.
- Local play: Custom Game button is now a bit more prominent than Automa button.
- Barred Owl on the overview screen will correctly display its egg slots now.
- AI fixes for When Played bird powers. 
- Easy AI was toned-down a bit.
- "All players draw a bird from the deck" brown power fix. (Allow other players to draw two cards in case you have more than one bird with that power, and also allow that power to be repeated)
- Keyboard shortcut "~" while having the overview open will work now.
- A number of typos fixed.

We are aware of the time-out issues in multi-player games and we are working on a fix. We will reset your Karma if you fall below 50. We are sorry for your trouble.

As always, if you encounter any issues while playing, please drop us a line at support@monstercouch.com or let us know via our discord: https://discord.gg/wingspan

And, if you're enjoying Wingspan, please consider taking a moment to leave a review -- they can go a long way in helping new players discover the game.

Thanks for your support! 
Monster Couch Team
